# React Native Styled System

> Token-driven styling for React Native. Pass design tokens as props, resolve them from a centralized theme, and ship consistent UI faster.

- Docs: https://mym0404.github.io/react-native-styled-system/
- GitHub: https://github.com/mym0404/react-native-styled-system
- Package: `@react-native-styled-system/core` (v2.0)
- Theme utilities: `@react-native-styled-system/util` (v2.0)
- CLI: `@react-native-styled-system/cli` (v2.0)
- License: MIT

---

## Installation

```sh
npm install @react-native-styled-system/core @react-native-styled-system/util
# or
yarn add @react-native-styled-system/core @react-native-styled-system/util
```

Peer dependencies: `react`, `react-native`

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Provider Setup

Wrap your app root with `StyledSystemProvider` and pass a theme object:

```tsx
import { StyledSystemProvider } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';
import { defaultTheme } from '@react-native-styled-system/util';

const App = () => (
  <StyledSystemProvider theme={defaultTheme}>
    <MyApp />
  </StyledSystemProvider>
);
```

`StyledSystemProvider` props:
- `theme: Partial<ThemedDict>` (required) - The theme object. Automatically filled with `createTheme()` internally.
- `screenWidth?: number` (optional) - Override screen width for responsive resolution. Defaults to `useWindowDimensions().width`.
- `children: ReactNode`

### 2. Create Styled Components

**HOC pattern** (recommended for simple components):

```tsx
import { View, Text, Image } from 'react-native';
import { createSxComponent, createSxTextComponent } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const Box = createSxComponent(View)();
const Txt = createSxTextComponent(Text)();
const StyledImage = createSxComponent(Image)();
```

**Hook pattern** (for custom logic):

```tsx
import { View, ViewProps } from 'react-native';
import { SxProps, useSx } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const Box = (props: ViewProps & SxProps) => {
  const { getStyle, filteredProps } = useSx(props);
  return <View style={getStyle()} {...filteredProps} />;
};
```

### 3. Use Token Props

```tsx
<Box bg={'primary'} p={4} radius={'lg'}>
  <Txt t={'h1'} color={'primary-foreground'}>
    Hello World
  </Txt>
</Box>

<Box bg={'red.500'} m={2} w={10} h={10} radius={'full'} />

<Txt t={'caption'} color={'muted-foreground'} align={'center'}>
  Styled System
</Txt>
```

---

## ThemedDict (Theme Shape)

```ts
type ThemedDict = {
  space: Record<string | number, SpaceValue>;
  sizes: Record<string | number, SizesValue>;
  colors: Record<string | number, ColorsValue>;
  radii: Record<string | number, RadiiValue>;
  typography: Record<string | number, TypographyValue>;
  breakpoints?: number[];
};
```

### Token Value Types

```ts
type SpaceValue = number | 'auto' | `${number}%` | null;
type SizesValue = number | 'auto' | `${number}%` | null;
type ColorsValue = string;
type RadiiValue = number;
type TypographyValue = {
  fontFamily?: string;
  fontSize?: number;
  fontWeight?: TextStyle['fontWeight'];
  lineHeight?: number;
  letterSpacing?: number;
  textAlign?: TextStyle['textAlign'];
  fontStyle?: TextStyle['fontStyle'];
};
```

---

## defaultTheme (`@react-native-styled-system/util`)

Pre-built production-ready theme included with the library. Contains:

### Space Tokens (4px unit scale)

| Key    | Value | Key    | Value | Key    | Value |
|--------|-------|--------|-------|--------|-------|
| `0`    | 0     | `5`    | 20    | `14`   | 56    |
| `px`   | 1     | `6`    | 24    | `16`   | 64    |
| `0.5`  | 2     | `7`    | 28    | `20`   | 80    |
| `1`    | 4     | `8`    | 32    | `24`   | 96    |
| `2`    | 8     | `9`    | 36    | `32`   | 128   |
| `3`    | 12    | `10`   | 40    | `40`   | 160   |
| `4`    | 16    | `12`   | 48    | `48`   | 192   |

### Size Tokens

Same as space tokens plus:
- `full` = `'100%'`
- `half` = `'50%'`

### Color Palette (Tailwind CSS v4)

22 color groups, each with 11 shades (50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 950):
- Gray scales: `slate`, `gray`, `zinc`, `neutral`, `stone`
- Colors: `red`, `orange`, `amber`, `yellow`, `lime`, `green`, `emerald`, `teal`, `cyan`, `sky`, `blue`, `indigo`, `violet`, `purple`, `fuchsia`, `pink`, `rose`
- Special: `white` (#FFFFFF), `black` (#000000), `transparent`

Color format: `{color}.{shade}` (e.g., `red.500`, `blue.200`, `neutral.900`)

The default theme also includes semantic colors generated by `createThemeColors({ base: 'neutral', theme: 'neutral' })` in light mode.

### Semantic Color Tokens (shadcn/ui convention)

Light mode defaults:
- `background`: #FFFFFF
- `foreground`: neutral.950 (#0a0a0a)
- `card`: #FFFFFF
- `card-foreground`: neutral.950
- `popover`: #FFFFFF
- `popover-foreground`: neutral.950
- `primary`: neutral.900 (#171717)
- `primary-foreground`: neutral.50 (#fafafa)
- `secondary`: neutral.100 (#f5f5f5)
- `secondary-foreground`: neutral.900
- `muted`: neutral.100
- `muted-foreground`: neutral.500 (#737373)
- `accent`: neutral.100
- `accent-foreground`: neutral.900
- `destructive`: red.600 (#e7000b)
- `destructive-foreground`: neutral.50
- `border`: neutral.200 (#e5e5e5)
- `input`: neutral.200
- `ring`: neutral.400 (#a1a1a1)
- `chart-1` through `chart-5`: preset chart colors

### Radii Tokens

| Key    | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `none` | 0     |
| `sm`   | 4     |
| `md`   | 8     |
| `lg`   | 12    |
| `xl`   | 16    |
| `2xl`  | 24    |
| `full` | 9999  |

### Typography Presets

| Key       | fontSize | fontWeight | lineHeight |
|-----------|----------|------------|------------|
| `h1`      | 32       | `'bold'`   | 40         |
| `h2`      | 24       | `'bold'`   | 32         |
| `h3`      | 20       | `'600'`    | 28         |
| `body`    | 16       | -          | 24         |
| `caption` | 14       | -          | 20         |
| `small`   | 12       | -          | 16         |

### Default Breakpoints

```ts
breakpoints: [480, 768, 1024]
```

---

## createTheme (`@react-native-styled-system/util`)

Two call signatures for creating/extending themes.

### Create mode (single argument)

Creates a new theme. Missing token categories default to `{}`, breakpoints to `[]`:

```ts
import { createTheme } from '@react-native-styled-system/util';

const theme = createTheme({
  colors: { primary: '#3B82F6' },
  space: { '1': 4, '2': 8 },
});
// Result: { colors: { primary: '#3B82F6' }, space: { '1': 4, '2': 8 }, sizes: {}, radii: {}, typography: {}, breakpoints: [] }
```

### Extend mode (two arguments)

Extends a base theme with overrides. Each token group is shallow-merged, breakpoints is replaced:

```ts
const theme = createTheme(defaultTheme, {
  colors: { brand: '#FF6600' },
  space: { pagePadding: 20 },
  breakpoints: [480, 1024],
});
// colors = { ...defaultTheme.colors, brand: '#FF6600' }
// space = { ...defaultTheme.space, pagePadding: 20 }
// breakpoints = [480, 1024]  (replaced, not merged)
```

---

## createThemeColors

Generates light and dark semantic color sets following shadcn/ui convention. Uses the Tailwind CSS v4 palette internally.

```ts
import { createThemeColors } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const { light, dark } = createThemeColors({
  base: 'zinc',
  theme: 'blue',
});
```

### Parameters

- `base: BaseColor` - Gray scale for neutral UI elements. One of: `'slate'` | `'gray'` | `'zinc'` | `'neutral'` | `'stone'`
- `theme: ThemeColor` - Accent color for primary/branded elements. One of: `BaseColor` | `'red'` | `'orange'` | `'amber'` | `'yellow'` | `'lime'` | `'green'` | `'emerald'` | `'teal'` | `'cyan'` | `'sky'` | `'blue'` | `'indigo'` | `'violet'` | `'purple'` | `'fuchsia'` | `'pink'` | `'rose'`

### Return Value

Returns `{ light: Record<string, ColorsValue>, dark: Record<string, ColorsValue> }`.

Both contain these semantic token keys:
`background`, `foreground`, `card`, `card-foreground`, `popover`, `popover-foreground`, `primary`, `primary-foreground`, `secondary`, `secondary-foreground`, `muted`, `muted-foreground`, `accent`, `accent-foreground`, `destructive`, `destructive-foreground`, `border`, `input`, `ring`, `chart-1`, `chart-2`, `chart-3`, `chart-4`, `chart-5`

### Color Generation Rules

For **light** mode:
- `background`: #FFFFFF
- `foreground`: base.950
- `primary`: theme.600 (or theme.900 for gray-scale themes)
- `primary-foreground`: #FFFFFF (or theme.50 for gray-scale themes)
- `secondary`, `muted`, `accent`: base.100
- `destructive`: red.600
- `border`, `input`: base.200
- `ring`: theme.400 (or base.400 for gray-scale themes)

For **dark** mode:
- `background`: base.950
- `foreground`: base.50
- `primary`: theme.500 (or theme.200 for gray-scale themes)
- `primary-foreground`: #FFFFFF (or theme.900 for gray-scale themes)
- `secondary`, `muted`, `accent`: base.800
- `destructive`: red.400
- `border`, `input`: base.800
- `ring`: theme.500 (or base.500 for gray-scale themes)

### Dark Mode Pattern

```tsx
const { light, dark } = createThemeColors({ base: 'neutral', theme: 'blue' });

const theme = useMemo(
  () => createTheme(defaultTheme, { colors: isDarkMode ? dark : light }),
  [isDarkMode],
);

<StyledSystemProvider theme={theme}>
```

---

## Hooks

### useSx

Primary hook for resolving style props. Takes component props and options, returns a style getter and filtered props.

```ts
import { useSx } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const { getStyle, filteredProps } = useSx(props, options);
```

**Parameters:**

- `props?: P | null` - Component props containing SxProps. Can be null/undefined.
- `options?: UseSxOptions` - Configuration object:

```ts
type UseSxOptions = {
  theme?: ThemedDict;        // Override context theme
  styleType?: 'ViewStyle' | 'TextStyle';  // Default: 'ViewStyle'
  transform?: (style: AnyStyle) => TextSxProps;  // Post-process computed style
  fallback?: Omit<TextSxProps, 'sx'>;  // Default style props (lowest priority)
  cache?: boolean;           // Enable object-hash based caching
  screenWidth?: number;      // Override context screen width
};
```

**Return value:**

- `getStyle(): StyleProp<AnyStyle> | undefined` - Stable callback that computes and returns the merged style. Call in the component's render.
- `filteredProps: Omit<P, SxPropsKeys | 'style'>` - Original props with all style-related props removed. Spread onto the base component.

**Style merge priority** (highest to lowest):
1. `style` prop (React Native inline style)
2. `sx` prop (SxProps object)
3. Direct props (e.g., `bg`, `p`, `mt` passed directly)
4. `fallback` option

Within each level, when both shortcut and full name are provided, the full name takes priority (e.g., `backgroundColor` overrides `bg`).

**Usage with View:**

```tsx
const Box = (props: ViewProps & SxProps) => {
  const { getStyle, filteredProps } = useSx(props);
  return <View style={getStyle()} {...filteredProps} />;
};
```

**Usage with Text:**

```tsx
const Txt = (props: TextProps & TextSxProps) => {
  const { getStyle, filteredProps } = useSx(props, {
    styleType: 'TextStyle',
    fallback: { color: 'foreground', includeFontPadding: false },
  });
  return <Text style={getStyle()} {...filteredProps} />;
};
```

**Usage with transform:**

```tsx
const { getStyle } = useSx(props, {
  transform: (computedStyle) => ({
    // Derive additional styles from the computed result
    borderColor: computedStyle.backgroundColor,
  }),
});
```

**Usage with cache:**

```tsx
const { getStyle } = useSx(props, { cache: true });
// Style objects with same token values return the same reference (via object-hash),
// preventing unnecessary re-renders in PureComponent/React.memo consumers.
```

### useSxStyle

Returns a function that converts SxProps into a TextStyle. Useful for ad-hoc style computation without component props.

```ts
import { useSxStyle } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const getSxStyle = useSxStyle({ cache: true });
const headerStyle = getSxStyle({ bg: 'primary', p: 4, radius: 'lg' });
const textStyle = getSxStyle({ color: 'foreground', t: 'h1' });
```

**Options:**

```ts
type UseSxStyleOptions = {
  theme?: ThemedDict;     // Override context theme
  cache?: boolean;        // Enable caching
  screenWidth?: number;   // Override screen width
};
```

### useSxTokens

Resolves raw token values by type. Returns an array of resolved values matching the input array.

```ts
import { useSxTokens } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const [bgColor, textColor] = useSxTokens('colors', ['red.500', 'blue.700']);
// bgColor = '#fb2c36', textColor = '#1447e6'

const [spaceSm, spaceLg] = useSxTokens('space', [2, 8]);
// spaceSm = 8, spaceLg = 32

const [radiusMd] = useSxTokens('radii', ['md']);
// radiusMd = 8
```

**Parameters:**

- `tokenType: keyof ThemedTypings` - One of: `'colors'`, `'space'`, `'sizes'`, `'radii'`, `'typography'`
- `tokenValues: Array<TokenValue>` - Array of token keys to resolve
- `options?: { theme?: ThemedDict }` - Optional theme override

---

## Component Factories (HOC)

### createSxComponent

Wraps any React Native component with `SxProps` support (ViewStyle only). Returns a curried factory.

```ts
import { createSxComponent } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

// Basic usage
const Box = createSxComponent(View)();

// With default props
const Card = createSxComponent(View)({
  defaultProps: { bg: 'card', p: 4, radius: 'lg' },
});

// With options
const CachedBox = createSxComponent(View)({
  sxOptions: { cache: true },
});
```

**Signature:**

```ts
function createSxComponent<Props, Ref>(Base: ComponentType<Props>):
  (config?: { defaultProps?: MergedProps; sxOptions?: UseSxOptions }) =>
    ForwardRefComponent<Ref, Omit<Props, keyof SxProps> & SxProps>;
```

The returned component:
- Accepts all original component props plus `SxProps`
- Supports `ref` forwarding
- Has `displayName` set to `Sx.{Base.displayName || Base.name}`

### createSxTextComponent

Same as `createSxComponent` but uses `TextSxProps` and `styleType: 'TextStyle'` by default.

```ts
import { createSxTextComponent } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const Txt = createSxTextComponent(Text)();

// With default text styling
const Label = createSxTextComponent(Text)({
  defaultProps: { t: 'caption', color: 'muted-foreground' },
});
```

---

## Style Props Reference

### SxProps (ViewStyle)

All props accept `Responsive<T>` (value or array) except `transform`.

#### Color Token Props

| Prop | Shortcut | Token Type | Description |
|------|----------|------------|-------------|
| `backgroundColor` | `bg` | `Token<'colors'>` | Background color |
| `borderColor` | - | `Token<'colors'>` | Border color |

#### Space Token Props

| Prop | Shortcut | Token Type | Maps To |
|------|----------|------------|---------|
| `margin` | `m` | `Token<'space'>` | `margin` |
| `marginTop` | `mt` | `Token<'space'>` | `marginTop` |
| `marginRight` | `mr` | `Token<'space'>` | `marginRight` |
| `marginBottom` | `mb` | `Token<'space'>` | `marginBottom` |
| `marginLeft` | `ml` | `Token<'space'>` | `marginLeft` |
| `marginX` | `mx` | `Token<'space'>` | `marginHorizontal` |
| `marginY` | `my` | `Token<'space'>` | `marginVertical` |
| `padding` | `p` | `Token<'space'>` | `padding` |
| `paddingTop` | `pt` | `Token<'space'>` | `paddingTop` |
| `paddingRight` | `pr` | `Token<'space'>` | `paddingRight` |
| `paddingBottom` | `pb` | `Token<'space'>` | `paddingBottom` |
| `paddingLeft` | `pl` | `Token<'space'>` | `paddingLeft` |
| `paddingX` | `px` | `Token<'space'>` | `paddingHorizontal` |
| `paddingY` | `py` | `Token<'space'>` | `paddingVertical` |
| `top` | - | `Token<'space'>` | `top` |
| `right` | - | `Token<'space'>` | `right` |
| `bottom` | - | `Token<'space'>` | `bottom` |
| `left` | - | `Token<'space'>` | `left` |
| `gap` | - | `Token<'space'>` | `gap` (number only) |
| `gapX` | - | `Token<'space'>` | `columnGap` (number only) |
| `gapY` | - | `Token<'space'>` | `rowGap` (number only) |

#### Size Token Props

| Prop | Shortcut | Token Type |
|------|----------|------------|
| `width` | `w` | `Token<'sizes'>` |
| `minWidth` | `minW` | `Token<'sizes'>` |
| `maxWidth` | `maxW` | `Token<'sizes'>` |
| `height` | `h` | `Token<'sizes'>` |
| `minHeight` | `minH` | `Token<'sizes'>` |
| `maxHeight` | `maxH` | `Token<'sizes'>` |

#### Radii Token Props

| Prop | Shortcut | Token Type |
|------|----------|------------|
| `borderRadius` | `radius` | `Token<'radii'>` |
| `borderTopLeftRadius` | `topLeftRadius` | `Token<'radii'>` |
| `borderTopRightRadius` | `topRightRadius` | `Token<'radii'>` |
| `borderBottomLeftRadius` | `bottomLeftRadius` | `Token<'radii'>` |
| `borderBottomRightRadius` | `bottomRightRadius` | `Token<'radii'>` |

#### View Style Props (no token resolution)

| Prop | Shortcut | Type |
|------|----------|------|
| `flex` | - | `ViewStyle['flex']` |
| `alignItems` | - | `ViewStyle['alignItems']` |
| `alignContent` | - | `ViewStyle['alignContent']` |
| `justifyContent` | - | `ViewStyle['justifyContent']` |
| `flexWrap` | - | `ViewStyle['flexWrap']` |
| `flexDirection` | - | `ViewStyle['flexDirection']` |
| `flexGrow` | - | `ViewStyle['flexGrow']` |
| `flexShrink` | - | `ViewStyle['flexShrink']` |
| `flexBasis` | - | `ViewStyle['flexBasis']` |
| `alignSelf` | - | `ViewStyle['alignSelf']` |
| `position` | `pos` | `ViewStyle['position']` |
| `borderWidth` | - | `ViewStyle['borderWidth']` |
| `borderTopWidth` | - | `ViewStyle['borderTopWidth']` |
| `borderRightWidth` | - | `ViewStyle['borderRightWidth']` |
| `borderBottomWidth` | - | `ViewStyle['borderBottomWidth']` |
| `borderLeftWidth` | - | `ViewStyle['borderLeftWidth']` |
| `opacity` | - | `ViewStyle['opacity']` |
| `overflow` | - | `ViewStyle['overflow']` |
| `transform` | - | `ViewStyle['transform']` |
| `aspectRatio` | - | `ViewStyle['aspectRatio']` |
| `display` | - | `ViewStyle['display']` |
| `elevation` | - | `ViewStyle['elevation']` |
| `zIndex` | - | `ViewStyle['zIndex']` |

#### Boolean Convenience Props

| Prop | Effect |
|------|--------|
| `absoluteFill` | Sets `position: 'absolute'` and `top/right/bottom/left: 0` |
| `center` | Sets `alignItems: 'center'` and `justifyContent: 'center'` |

### TextSxProps (extends SxProps)

Includes all SxProps plus text-specific props. Used with `styleType: 'TextStyle'`.

#### Text Color Props

| Prop | Token Type |
|------|------------|
| `color` | `Token<'colors'>` |
| `textDecorationColor` | `Token<'colors'>` |
| `textShadowColor` | `Token<'colors'>` |

#### Typography Token Props

| Prop | Shortcut | Description |
|------|----------|-------------|
| `typography` | `t` | `Token<'typography'>` - Applies all typography properties (fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight, letterSpacing, textAlign, fontStyle) from the matched preset |

When `t`/`typography` is set, individual text props can still override:

```tsx
// Uses h1 preset but overrides fontWeight
<Txt t={'h1'} weight={'normal'}>Light Heading</Txt>
```

#### Text Style Props

| Prop | Shortcut | Type |
|------|----------|------|
| `fontFamily` | - | `TextStyle['fontFamily']` |
| `fontSize` | - | `TextStyle['fontSize']` |
| `fontStyle` | - | `TextStyle['fontStyle']` |
| `fontWeight` | `weight` | `TextStyle['fontWeight']` |
| `letterSpacing` | - | `TextStyle['letterSpacing']` |
| `lineHeight` | - | `TextStyle['lineHeight']` |
| `textAlign` | `align` | `TextStyle['textAlign']` |
| `textDecorationLine` | - | `TextStyle['textDecorationLine']` |
| `textDecorationStyle` | - | `TextStyle['textDecorationStyle']` |
| `textShadowOffset` | - | `TextStyle['textShadowOffset']` |
| `textShadowRadius` | - | `TextStyle['textShadowRadius']` |
| `textTransform` | - | `TextStyle['textTransform']` |
| `userSelect` | - | `TextStyle['userSelect']` |
| `includeFontPadding` | - | `TextStyle['includeFontPadding']` (Android) |

### The sx Prop

Both `SxProps` and `TextSxProps` accept an `sx` prop for grouping styles:

```tsx
<Box sx={{ bg: 'primary', p: 4, radius: 'lg' }} />
```

Priority: direct props are applied first, then `sx` overrides them.

### Complete Shortcut Map

| Shortcut | Full Name |
|----------|-----------|
| `bg` | `backgroundColor` |
| `m` | `margin` |
| `mt` | `marginTop` |
| `mr` | `marginRight` |
| `mb` | `marginBottom` |
| `ml` | `marginLeft` |
| `mx` | `marginX` |
| `my` | `marginY` |
| `p` | `padding` |
| `pt` | `paddingTop` |
| `pr` | `paddingRight` |
| `pb` | `paddingBottom` |
| `pl` | `paddingLeft` |
| `px` | `paddingX` |
| `py` | `paddingY` |
| `w` | `width` |
| `minW` | `minWidth` |
| `maxW` | `maxWidth` |
| `h` | `height` |
| `minH` | `minHeight` |
| `maxH` | `maxHeight` |
| `radius` | `borderRadius` |
| `topLeftRadius` | `borderTopLeftRadius` |
| `topRightRadius` | `borderTopRightRadius` |
| `bottomLeftRadius` | `borderBottomLeftRadius` |
| `bottomRightRadius` | `borderBottomRightRadius` |
| `pos` | `position` |
| `weight` | `fontWeight` |
| `align` | `textAlign` |
| `t` | `typography` |

---

## Responsive Values

Any style prop (except `transform`) accepts an array for responsive breakpoint-based values. Uses a mobile-first approach.

### How It Works

```ts
type Responsive<T> = T | (T | undefined)[];
```

Array indices map to breakpoints:
- Index 0: base value (all screen sizes)
- Index 1: applied when `screenWidth >= breakpoints[0]`
- Index 2: applied when `screenWidth >= breakpoints[1]`
- Index N: applied when `screenWidth >= breakpoints[N-1]`

### Examples

```tsx
// Default breakpoints: [480, 768, 1024]

// Width: 100 (base), 200 (>=480px), 300 (>=768px), 400 (>=1024px)
<Box w={[100, 200, 300, 400]} />

// Direction: column (base), row (>=480px)
<Box flexDirection={['column', 'row']} />

// Background: red on mobile, blue on tablet+
<Box bg={['red.500', 'blue.500']} />

// Padding: 4 (base), 6 (>=480px), 8 (>=768px)
<Box px={[4, 6, 8]} />

// Skip a breakpoint with undefined
<Box w={[100, undefined, 300]} />
// 100 for <480px, undefined for >=480px, 300 for >=768px
```

### Resolution Algorithm

```
resolveResponsiveValue({ value, breakpoints, screenWidth }):
  if value is not an array → return value as-is
  resolved = value[0]  (base)
  for each breakpoint[i]:
    if screenWidth >= breakpoint[i] AND value[i+1] exists:
      resolved = value[i+1]
  return resolved
```

If the array is shorter than breakpoints+1, the last matched value persists for larger screens.

---

## Token Resolution

### How Tokens Are Parsed

Each token type has its own parser that resolves token keys to concrete values.

#### Colors Parser

1. If the token key exists in `theme.colors` → return the mapped value
2. Otherwise → return the token value as-is (passthrough, allows raw CSS color strings)

```tsx
<Box bg={'red.500'} />        // Resolved from theme: '#fb2c36'
<Box bg={'primary'} />        // Resolved from theme: semantic color
<Box bg={'#custom123'} />     // Passthrough: '#custom123'
<Box bg={'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'} /> // Passthrough: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
```

#### Space Parser

1. If the value has a `px` suffix and is a valid number → parse as number (e.g., `'16px'` → `16`)
2. If the token key exists in `theme.space` → return the mapped value
3. If the value is a number, also try its string representation as a key
4. Negative values: `-4` looks up `4` in theme and negates the result
5. String starting with `-`: `'-4'` looks up `'4'` and negates
6. If it's a numeric string → parse as number
7. Otherwise → return as-is

```tsx
<Box p={4} />          // Looks up '4' in theme.space → 16
<Box p={'4'} />        // Same: looks up '4' → 16
<Box m={-4} />         // Looks up '4' → 16, negates → -16
<Box m={'16px'} />     // Parsed as px suffix → 16
<Box p={'auto'} />     // Passthrough: 'auto'
```

#### Sizes Parser

Similar to space parser but without negative value handling:
1. `px` suffix parsing
2. Theme lookup
3. Numeric string parsing
4. Passthrough

#### Radii Parser

1. `px` suffix parsing
2. Theme lookup
3. Numeric string parsing
4. Passthrough (must be number)

```tsx
<Box radius={'lg'} />    // Looks up 'lg' → 12
<Box radius={'8px'} />   // Parsed as px → 8
<Box radius={16} />      // Looks up '16' in theme, or passthrough → 16
```

#### Typography Parser

Token must be a string. Looks up in `theme.typography` and returns the `TypographyValue` object. Non-matching keys return undefined.

```tsx
<Txt t={'h1'} />     // Returns { fontSize: 32, fontWeight: 'bold', lineHeight: 40 }
<Txt t={'body'} />   // Returns { fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 24 }
```

Individual text style props override typography preset values:

```tsx
<Txt t={'h1'} fontSize={20} />  // fontSize=20 overrides preset's 32
```

---

## propsToThemedStyle

Pure function that converts SxProps to React Native style objects. Used internally by `useSx` and `useSxStyle`.

```ts
import { propsToThemedStyle } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const style = propsToThemedStyle({
  theme: myTheme,
  sx: { bg: 'primary', p: 4 },
  styleType: 'ViewStyle',    // or 'TextStyle'
  breakpoints: [480, 768],
  screenWidth: 600,
});
```

---

## CLI: Type Generation

The `@react-native-styled-system/cli` package generates TypeScript type augmentations from your theme file, enabling autocomplete for all token keys.

### Installation

```sh
npm install -D @react-native-styled-system/cli
```

### Usage

```sh
npx generate-theme-type generate src/AppTheme.ts --out src/theme.d.ts
```

**Options:**
- `generate <source>` - Path to your theme file (JS or TS). The file should export the theme as `default`, `theme`, or module.
- `--out <path>` - Output path for the generated type file
- `--no-format` - Disable auto formatting with Prettier

### Theme File Guidelines

- Keep `theme.ts` focused on token construction only.
- Import only what you need for theme composition (`createTheme`, `defaultTheme`, `createThemeColors`).
- Avoid unrelated imports (components, hooks, screens, app runtime modules), which can break CLI bundling.

### What It Generates

The CLI reads your theme file via `bundle-n-require`, extracts token keys from each category, and generates a TypeScript interface that augments `ThemedTypings`:

```ts
// Generated file
import { BaseThemeTypings } from "./shared.types.js"
export interface ThemeTypings extends BaseThemeTypings {
  colors: "white" | "black" | "red.50" | "red.100" | ... | "primary" | "background" | ...
  space: "0" | "px" | "0.5" | "1" | "-1" | "2" | "-2" | ...
  sizes: "0" | "px" | "full" | "half" | ...
  radii: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | ...
  typography: "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "body" | "caption" | "small"
}
```

### Configuration

Token extraction config:
- `colors`: max scan depth 3 (supports nested like `red.500`)
- `radii`: default scan depth
- `sizes`: max scan depth 2
- `space`: generates negative variants (e.g., `'4'` also generates `'-4'`)

---

## Advanced Patterns

### Dynamic Theme Values

Inject runtime values (like safe area insets) into theme tokens:

```tsx
const safeArea = useSafeAreaInsets();

const theme = useMemo(
  () => createTheme(defaultTheme, {
    space: {
      sfTop: safeArea.top,
      sfBottom: safeArea.bottom,
      sfLeft: safeArea.left,
      sfRight: safeArea.right,
    },
  }),
  [safeArea],
);

// Then use as tokens:
<Box pt={'sfTop'} pb={'sfBottom'} />
```

### ScrollView with Content Container Styles

```tsx
const StyledScrollView = forwardRef((props, ref) => {
  const { getStyle, filteredProps } = useSx(props);
  const { getStyle: getContentStyle } = useSx(props.contentContainerSx);

  return (
    <ScrollView
      ref={ref}
      style={getStyle()}
      contentContainerStyle={getContentStyle()}
      {...filteredProps}
    />
  );
});
```

### Theme Presets

```tsx
const presets = [
  { base: 'neutral', theme: 'neutral' },
  { base: 'zinc', theme: 'blue' },
  { base: 'slate', theme: 'violet' },
  { base: 'stone', theme: 'rose' },
];

const { light, dark } = createThemeColors(presets[selectedIndex]);
```

---

## Exported API Summary

Core exports from `@react-native-styled-system/core`:

### Types
- `ThemedDict` - Theme shape interface
- `SxProps` - View style props with responsive wrapping
- `TextSxProps` - Text style props (extends SxProps) with responsive wrapping
- `ResolvedSxProps` - SxProps after responsive resolution
- `ResolvedTextSxProps` - TextSxProps after responsive resolution
- `SxPropsKeys` - Union of all SxProps key names
- `TextSxPropsKey` - Union of all TextSxProps key names
- `ThemedTypings` - Token type mapping (augmentable via CLI)
- `Responsive<T>` - `T | (T | undefined)[]`
- `ResponsiveExcludedKey` - `'transform'`
- `Token<ThemeKey>` - Token value type for a given theme key
- `SpaceValue`, `SizesValue`, `ColorsValue`, `RadiiValue`, `TypographyValue` - Raw token value types
- `BaseColor` - `'slate' | 'gray' | 'zinc' | 'neutral' | 'stone'`
- `ThemeColor` - BaseColor plus all Tailwind color names
- `UseSxOptions` - Options for useSx hook
- `UseSxStyleOptions` - Options for useSxStyle hook
- `UseSxTokensOptions` - Options for useSxTokens hook
- `StyleTransform` - Transform function type `(style: AnyStyle) => TextSxProps`
- `StyleFallback` - Fallback type `Omit<TextSxProps, 'sx'>`
- `ThemedStyleType` - `'ViewStyle' | 'TextStyle'`
- `StyledSystemContextValue` - `{ theme: ThemedDict; screenWidth: number }`

### Components
- `StyledSystemProvider` - React Context provider

### Hooks
- `useSx` - Primary style resolution hook
- `useSxStyle` - Ad-hoc style computation
- `useSxTokens` - Raw token value access

### Functions
- `createThemeColors` - Generate semantic color sets
- `createSxComponent` - HOC factory for View-style components
- `createSxTextComponent` - HOC factory for Text-style components
- `propsToThemedStyle` - Pure style resolution function

### Constants
- `emptyThemedDict` - Empty theme (all categories `{}`, breakpoints `[]`)
- `SHORTCUT_NAME_MAP` - Shortcut to full prop name mapping
- `RESPONSIVE_EXCLUDED_KEYS` - Set of keys excluded from responsive resolution (`transform`)
- `_viewStylePropList` - Array of view-related SxProps keys
- `_textStylePropList` - Array of text-related SxProps keys

Theme utilities from `@react-native-styled-system/util`:
- `createTheme` - Create or extend themes
- `defaultTheme` - Pre-built theme with Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui

---

## Architecture Overview

```
StyledSystemProvider (React Context)
  ├── Provides: ThemedDict + screenWidth
  └── Wraps theme with createTheme() to fill defaults

useSx(props, options)
  ├── Reads theme + screenWidth from context (or options override)
  ├── mutateShortcutPropToOriginalKeys() - expands shortcuts
  ├── Merges: fallback < props < sx (shortcut-expanded)
  ├── propsToThemedStyle() - resolves tokens to RN styles
  │   ├── resolveResponsiveSx() - resolves responsive arrays
  │   └── TokenParsers (colors, space, sizes, radii, typography)
  ├── Appends style prop on top (highest priority)
  ├── Optional: transform() post-processing
  ├── Optional: getCachedStyle() via object-hash
  └── Returns: { getStyle, filteredProps }
```
